SELECT A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finProdMarketId, A.FINPROD_ID finprodId, IFNULL(A.FINPROD_ABBR, a.FINPROD_NAME) finProdName, B.VAL_DATE valDate, B.VALUATION valuation, DATE_FORMAT(B.CREATE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d') importDate FROM FIN_PRODUCT A , FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION B WHERE A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID=B.FINPROD_ID AND A.PROFIT_TYPE IN (#{PROFITTYPE_VALUE_01,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{PROFITTYPE_VALUE_03,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND A.FINPROD_TYPE2=#{TYPE_TOUGUAN_F17,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND A.FINPROD_ABBR like concat(concat('%', #{finProdName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')
AND A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat(concat('%', #{finProdMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')
AND B.VAL_DATE =STR_TO_DATE (#{valDate},'%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT DISTINCT A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID code, IFNULL(A.FINPROD_ABBR, a.FINPROD_NAME) name, A.FINPROD_ABBR shortName, A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID hidCode FROM FIN_PRODUCT A,FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION B WHERE A.FINPROD_ID=B.FINPROD_ID AND A.FINPROD_ABBR like concat(concat('%', IFNULL(#{finProdName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ,'')),'%') AND A.PROFIT_TYPE=#{PROFITTYPE_VALUE_01} AND A.FINPROD_TYPE2=#{TYPE_TOUGUAN_F17}

SELECT DISTINCT A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID code, IFNULL(A.FINPROD_ABBR, a.FINPROD_NAME) name, A.FINPROD_ABBR shortName, A.FINPROD_ID hidCode FROM FIN_PRODUCT A,FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION B WHERE A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID=B.FINPROD_ID AND (A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat(concat('%', IFNULL(#{finProdMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ,'')),'%') OR A.FINPROD_ABBR like concat(concat('%', IFNULL( #{finProdMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'')),'%') OR A.FINPROD_NAME like concat(concat('%',IFNULL( #{finProdMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'') ),'%') ) AND A.PROFIT_TYPE IN (#{PROFITTYPE_VALUE_01,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{PROFITTYPE_VALUE_03,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND A.FINPROD_TYPE2=#{TYPE_TOUGUAN_F17}

SELECT B.FINPROD_ID finprodId, B.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finProdMarketId, IFNULL(B.FINPROD_ABBR, B.FINPROD_NAME) finProdName, C.VAL_DATE valDate, A.CUSTOMER_NAME fundManager, C.VALUATION valuation， B.PROFIT_TYPE FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO A, FIN_PRODUCT B, FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION C WHERE C.FINPROD_ID=B.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AND B.MANAGER=A.CUSTOMER_ID(+) AND B.FINPROD_ID=#{finprodId}
AND A.IS_ASSTE_MANAGER(+)=#{YESORNO_YES_01,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND C.VAL_DATE=STR_TO_DATE (#{valDate},'%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT IFNULL(B.FINPROD_ABBR, B.FINPROD_NAME) finProdName, A.CUSTOMER_NAME fundManager, B.FINPROD_ID finprodId FROM FIN_PRODUCT B LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO A ON B.MANAGER=A.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE B.FINPROD_MARKET_ID=#{finProdMarketId} AND B.PROFIT_TYPE=#{profitType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.IS_ASSTE_MANAGER=#{YESORNO_YES_01,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
